title.en: Modern Frontend Web Development with React

description.id: Kurikulum komprehensif pengembangan antarmuka web modern berbasis komponen React, pengelolaan data global, dan konsumsi REST API asynchronous.
description.en: Comprehensive curriculum covering modern React component architecture, global state management, and asynchronous REST API integration.

description.id: Standar kompetensi kerja nasional mencakup implementasi algoritma pemrograman terstruktur, manipulasi basis data relasional, dan praktik keamanan dasar web.
description.en: National work competency standard covering structured programming algorithms, relational database operations, and web security best practices.

title.en: Backend Web Development with Laravel & Databases

description.id: Perancangan RESTful API, validasi request data, middleware otentikasi token, serta integrasi query relasional Eloquent ORM dengan MySQL.
description.en: RESTful API architecture, request data validation, token authentication middleware, and Eloquent ORM relational database queries in MySQL.

description.id: Pemodelan data entitas-relasi (ERD), normalisasi tabel hingga bentuk 3NF, serta penulisan query SQL teroptimasi untuk performa sistem.
description.en: Entity-relationship data modeling (ERD), relational table normalization up to 3NF, and optimized SQL query authoring for system performance.
